name: Phoveus
description: Phoveus is a BNB Chain yield and tokenized-stock market-clock intelligence agent. It compares on-chain token prices with reference prices, tracks market state and reference age, detects divergence, and fails closed during reopening-risk states. Read-only DeFi analytics include PancakeSwap BNB Chain indexed pools (TVL, 24h volume, source-reported APR) and Venus USDT supply-market data. These analytics are informational, not audited recommendations; Phoveus does not execute swaps, deposits, or redemptions through these integrations. Tokenized-stock order execution remains disabled. ERC-8004 identity registration is pending until the campaign wallet signs and the on-chain agentId is verified.
